provenance.zh: 柱高和误差人工估读；示例散点由均值及误差构造，不是真实重复
provenance.en: Manual estimates of means and errors; example points are constructed from those summaries, not measured replicates.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个 PARP1 变体、药物条件和生物学重复的 GFP 读数与样本 ID。
背景扣除、−DOX/DMSO 对照、FC 的归一化与配对规则。
真实重复值、汇总误差类型及检验结果；不要用 mean ± error 充当重复。
en: GFP measurements and biological replicate IDs for each PARP1 variant and drug condition.
Background subtraction, −DOX/DMSO controls, fold-change normalization and pairing rules.
Actual replicate values, summary-error definition and test results; mean ± error is not a substitute for replicates.

preprocessing.zh: 先完成 FC 归一化并提供实际重复值。截图示例中的点来自估计汇总，不可用于统计推断。
preprocessing.en: Normalize fold changes upstream and provide actual replicates. Screenshot-example points constructed from estimated summaries cannot support inference.
